title: Elipses of thought And queries fall Pages Fail for missing dots or for quotes never closed Needles of Spelless Merwins Truth musicians Kins of knotted
summary: Elipses of thought And queries fall Pages Fail for missing dots or for quotes never closed Needles of Spelless Merwins Truth musicians Kins of knotted Nets Casting knowledge Across an abyss Place my punctuation Oh so carefully So I sail #smallpoems #mb
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Elipses of thought
And queries fall
Pages
Fail
for missing dots
or
for quotes
never closed
Needles of
Spelless Merwins
Truth musicians
Kins of knotted
Nets
Casting knowledge
Across an abyss
Place my punctuation
Oh so carefully
So I sail
#smallpoems
#mb
